heading: Faisal Town Phase 2 Questions
faqsText:
What plot options can I explore? | Compare full-payment plots in Ring Road Block and Sectors O, P, Q, R, S and T. Send your budget and preferred size for a tailored shortlist. | yes
What is the starting full-payment price? | Ring Road Block and Sector T list 5.56 Marla plots from PKR 27.90 Lac. Ask for current available plot numbers and your complete quotation. | yes
Which sizes are available in O, Q and R? | Current options in these Model Blocks start from 8 Marla. Explore each block’s map and price table to compare locations. | yes
What makes Sector P different? | Sector P / The Caladan has its own premium full-payment price plan and dedicated sector layout. | yes
Can I explore K Block payment options? | Limited installment options may be available in K Block for 10 marla and above. Ask us to confirm current options and terms. | yes
Can you help me choose a location? | Yes. Share your budget, plot size and preferred sector. We can help you compare maps, mark a shortlist and arrange a site visit. | yes
Can I get help from outside Pakistan? | Yes. Use WhatsApp for plot details, maps, current walkthrough requests and help arranging a local visit. | yes
